Invariant: Build adjacency lists and run depth-first search with a visited set.
Edge cases: Six local tests include examples and relevant boundaries.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public boolean validPath(int n,int[][] edges,int source,int destination){List<List<Integer>>g=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)g.add(new ArrayList<>());for(int[]e:edges){g.get(e[0]).add(e[1]);g.get(e[1]).add(e[0]);}boolean[]seen=new boolean[n];ArrayDeque<Integer>st=new ArrayDeque<>();st.push(source);seen[source]=true;while(!st.isEmpty()){int x=st.pop();if(x==destination)return true;for(int y:g.get(x))if(!seen[y]){seen[y]=true;st.push(y);}}return false;} }
complexity_reason: Build adjacency lists and run depth-first search with a visited set.
